definition: Declared targets, build artifacts, and locally exercised behavior are separate; a framework target is not verified application support.

cn1.build: Maven mac-source + ParparVM + Xcode Release; ARM64 AppKit/Metal application
cn1.exercise: Native ribbon, Aqua OS menus, Command-F, word count, typing across paragraph breaks, styles, bullets, undo/redo, DOCX export/native chooser reopen and PDF export exercised. Complex IME and full fidelity not certified. Thirteen Mailings workflows and seven citation regressions pass, with original XML and recipient state restored. Current build also passes seven comparison workflows and thirteen Mailings regressions with exact XML restoration. The navigation checkpoint passes 32 native Mac checks (12 navigation, 20 comparison/Mailings). The typing checkpoint passes 32 Mac paragraph/typing/formatting/paste and ribbon checks. The table-cell comment checkpoint passes 32 native checks, including twelve cell-comment ribbon workflows, with original XML and recipient state restored. Full platform parity remains uncertified. The preceding grapheme checkpoint has separately dated keyboard evidence; see grapheme-acceptance.json. The comment-controls checkpoint passes 42 native checks, including 22 comment edit/navigation workflows; docs/comment-controls-acceptance.json records exact scope and restoration. The 2026-10-16 recipient-management checkpoint passes 22 native MCP checks; see docs/recipient-management-acceptance.json.

cn1.build: Codename One target; native application not built or tested on this platform

Linux ARM64 builds through the standard local Maven/ParparVM target in an isolated Ubuntu 22.04 container. The review binary uses RelWithDebInfo without release LTO and opt-in loopback MCP; it is not a performance/release-size baseline.
cn1.exercise: Thirty-seven Linux checks pass: seven comparison, thirteen Mailings, thirteen XTest document keyboard/Unicode/clipboard checks and four dialog input/focus/field-isolation checks. Exact original XML and Mailings recipient state were restored. Xvfb without a window manager does not certify title controls, physical input, printing or native file dialogs. The navigation checkpoint passes 59 native Linux checks (22 navigation, 37 existing regressions). The typing checkpoint passes 73 checks including GTK menu accelerator dispatch and paragraph/typing undo. The table-cell comment checkpoint passes 121 native checks, including twelve cell-comment ribbon workflows, with original XML and recipient state restored. Full platform parity remains uncertified. The preceding grapheme checkpoint has separately dated keyboard evidence; see grapheme-acceptance.json. The comment-controls checkpoint passes 131 native checks, including 22 comment edit/navigation workflows; docs/comment-controls-acceptance.json records exact scope and restoration.

cn1.build: Last verified build: grapheme checkpoint, ParparVM JavaScript. Table-cell comment source has not been rebuilt or accepted in the browser.
cn1.exercise: Current browser UI: real multiline text entry, document comparison, accept/undo/reject and recovery across reload pass. Revision markup visually checked; developer warnings/errors empty. Earlier Mailings workflows also passed. Broader and mobile-browser acceptance incomplete. The current typing source passes nine desktop Chrome keyboard/recovery checks, including paragraph movement and grouped undo/redo. The preceding grapheme checkpoint has separately dated keyboard evidence; see grapheme-acceptance.json. Comment editing/navigation source is not accepted on this platform yet.
